question: When finite measurement makes reliability ordering uncertain, can measurement-adjusted transport be separated from sampling instability and connected to decisions without target leakage?

predictor_families.adequacy_rule: finite, non-degenerate predictions on the frozen 243-label surface; source OOF fidelity must be reported before any target outcome is loaded

decision.promotion_rule: promote weighted transport only if held-out MAE improves beyond mean shift and global D_adj and is not explained by Jaccard

kill_switches: Do not claim uniform superiority of D_adj unless both simulation laws support the same finite-measurement advantage.
Do not promote a predictor family that fails the source-side adequacy rule.
Do not promote a new dataset with unresolved context, batch, or harvest-time confounding.
Do not promote weighted decision transport without held-out improvement beyond mean shift and global D_adj.
Do not call post-hoc perturbation/pathway associations causal.
Do not expand the active-audit heuristic after the preregistered negative result.

promotion.main_text: formal estimator, finite-measurement simulation, and only supported cross-family or decision evidence
promotion.supplement_only: external controls, weak/failed families, provenance-blocked datasets, active-audit replay, and exploratory diagnostics
